description: A short in-world post authored as a character, anchored to a point in story time.

author.description: Registry id of the character speaking.

text.description: The post body, in the character's own voice.

storyTime.description: Informal in-story time of day from the source frontmatter, e.g. `late evening`.

chapterRef.description: Reveal gate: the chapter a reader must have reached before this post is safe to show, e.g. `book1#ch12`.

publishDate.description: Release gate: real-world date the post becomes servable. Absent means released.

inReplyTo.description: Post id this one answers, so a thread reads as a thread.

mentions.description: Registry ids of characters named in the post.

placeRef.description: Place id the post is pinned to, so it also surfaces on that location.

tags.description: Labels carried through from the source frontmatter.

createdAt.description: Story time as an RFC3339 datetime.
